goal: test/paginate.test.mjs fails after a refactor of src/paginate.mjs. Fix paginate(items, page, size) without changing the existing assertions: pages are numbered from 1, pages is the number of pages needed to show every item (0 for an empty list), a page past the end returns no items, and a page or size that is not a positive integer throws a RangeError. Add tests for the empty list, the page past the end and the invalid arguments. node --test must pass.
